message:
Stiffening out of the walking band is disproportionate for this 40 m span, Manager, so pure added damping governs over added steel.

In plain words the added damper weight is about one person against a crowded deck of a hundred. Moving 1.9 Hz to 2.3 Hz needs 46.5 percent more stiffness from the stiffness-increase calculation (E27), while total Tuned Mass Damper, defined as Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), weight 7.85 kN from the static-weight calculation (E26) against 600 kN live load from the live-load estimate (E30) is 1.31 percent from the weight-fraction calculation (E72) and meets the 2 percent rule, so I drop stiffening.

Friction grip without welds is buildable if preload upkeep is locked in, Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead.

In plain words one bolt can hold the push in slip but several plus re-torque are needed to survive loosening at 1.9 Hz. I take from the 1 Experiments on coldformed steel momentresisting connections with 2 bolting frictionslip mechanism (E57) that slip is per EN 1993-1-8 with friction 0.3, giving 32.9 kN per bolt from the slip-resistance calculation (E64) against 13.1 kN demand from the combined-load calculation (E65), about seventeen body weights, so four bolts give redundancy; I take from the (PDF) Loss of preload in pretensioned bolts (E58) that preload loss must be checked with the fatigue concern in the injection-bolt source (E24), which from my discipline means annual Below Bridge Access Vehicle, defined as Below Bridge Access Vehicle (BBAV), re-torque per the inspection-access rule (E49) put by Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead, confirmed as serviceable from below with no deck hatch.

Sag plus shake plus stop hit all fit inside the girders and prove Medium comfort, Pedestrian Comfort and Safety Assessor and Structural Dynamicist.

In plain words the soft spring stretches more than it shakes and that total plus the stop cage stays above the bottom flange. Static sag 74.7 mm from the static-sag calculation (E63) plus 49.4 mm stroke from the free-decay simulation (E17) totals 124 mm from the envelope calculation (E68), a hand length well below a door width, inside girder depth per the layout sketch (E55), with stop hit 8.40 kN from the stop-force calculation (E66) inside 13.1 kN beam demand; I confirm what Structural Dynamicist takes from the MTMD robustness finding (E48) that detuned twins hold the band, proven by 0.67 m/s2 retrofitted from the crowd build-up simulation (E45) at 0.068 g inside Medium versus 8.28 m/s2 bare from the bare-acceleration calculation (E43) at 0.844 g almost body weight.

My position is ready, because weight, clamp with upkeep, and stop-into-beam checks close my domain on proposal v1.
